dct_description_sm: This project aims to assess Microplastics and associated legacy chemicals in snow, as a source of contaminants to the region; Microplastics and associated legacy chemicals in Arctic char gut content and muscle tissue; Microplastics and associated legacy chemicals in Arctic char habitat (water and sediment); Microplastics as a vector for legacy contaminants in Arctic coastal ecosystems.
dct_title_s: Investigating Microplastics and Associated Chemical Contamination in Arctic Char and their Marine and Freshwater Habitats Near Cambridge Bay, Nunavut
